name: get_calendar_layers
description: Get calendar layers (events+tasks+habits) overlay. Default layers=all when omitted. Covers full time range with timezone-aware day slicing. Useful for 'today what's up' view. Returns CalendarLayerResponse.

name: query_data_center
description: Universal query for calendar data center (read semantic POST). Supports search/objectType/source filters with pagination. Returns DataCenterQueryResponse.

name: preview_data_center_batch
description: Preview data-center batch operation (read-only, does not execute). Returns risk level, affected count, summary.

name: get_data_center_audit_export
description: Export audit log for data center in time range. Returns AuditExportResponse.

name: preview_data_center_restore
description: Preview restore from audit version (read-only, does not restore). Returns RestorePreview.

name: get_projects
description: List domain projects. Returns DomainProject[].

name: get_task_books
description: List task books. Returns TaskBook[].

name: get_habits
description: List habit routines. Optional time filter. Returns HabitRoutine[].

name: get_availability_windows
description: List availability windows. Returns AvailabilityWindow[]. If start/end omitted, returns all.

name: get_reminders
description: List reminders. Optional time range filter (applied locally if API ignores). Returns Reminder[].

name: get_reminder_delivery_log
description: Get reminder delivery log. Returns ReminderDelivery[].

name: get_reports
description: List report artifacts. Optional time range. Returns ReportArtifact[].

name: get_report
description: Get single report artifact by id. Returns ReportArtifact.

name: get_calendars
description: List all calendars. Returns Calendar[].

name: get_events
description: List calendar events with optional time range and calendar filter. Core query. Returns Event[] (PagedResult when page params sent).

name: get_tasks
description: List tasks filtered by status and calendar. Returns Task[] (PagedResult when filters present).

name: get_task_segments
description: List execution segments for a task. Returns TaskExecutionSegment[].

name: get_recycle_bin
description: List recycle-bin items. Optional type filter (calendar/event/task). Returns RecycleBinItem[].

name: preview_recycle_bin_restore
description: Preview recycle-bin restore (read-only, does not restore). Returns RestorePreview.

name: get_export_ics
description: Export ICS text for events in range. Returns ics text. calendarId filters by calendar (best-effort), ids is comma-separated event ids.

name: get_outlook_settings
description: Get Outlook sync settings (read-only). Returns OutlookSettingsResponse.

name: get_outlook_sync_batches
description: List Outlook sync batches. Returns SyncBatch[] with pagination.

name: get_outlook_local_data_preview
description: Preview local Outlook data counts (read-only). Returns Preview with binding/calendar/event counts.

name: get_event_by_id
description: Get single event by id. Tries direct fetch, falls back to filtered list. Returns Event. Note: fallback scans 730-day window page 1 only; if not found try broader search via search_pim.

name: get_task_by_id
description: Get single task by id. Falls back to filtered list if direct endpoint missing. Returns Task. Fallback limited to page 1.

name: get_habit_occurrences
description: List occurrences for a habit in range. Returns Occurrence[]. Uses data-center query as primary (no dedicated GET).

name: get_schedule_preview
description: Get schedule preview (read-only). Returns SchedulePlan. If taskIds omitted, previews all pending tasks.

name: get_calendar_by_id
description: Get single calendar by id (via list filter). Returns Calendar.

name: get_task_checklist
description: Get checklist items for a task. Returns ChecklistItem[]. Best-effort (no dedicated GET).

name: search_calendar_events
description: Search calendar events by keyword with optional time range. Returns Event[]. Uses /calendar/events?search and falls back to /search.

name: search_calendar_tasks
description: Search calendar tasks by keyword with optional time range. Returns Task[].

name: get_pc_summary
description: Get PC summary for a day. Returns PcSummaryResponse. date format YYYY-MM-DD.

name: get_pc_detail
description: Get PC detail records with filters. Returns TypedDetailQueryResponse. Supports redactUrls for url hashing.

name: get_pc_timeline
description: Get PC timeline v1 (raw). Returns TimelineItem[] for a day.

name: get_pc_timeline_v2
description: Get PC timeline v2 (smoothed with classification). Returns TimelineV2Item[]. Preferred over v1.

name: get_pc_heatmap
description: Get PC heatmap grid. Returns HeatmapGridResponse. dimension=day.

name: get_pc_activity_analysis
description: Get PC activity analysis for a day with blockMinutes (15/30/60). Returns PcActivityAnalysisResponse.

name: get_pc_quality
description: Get PC data quality report. Returns PcQualityResponse. Supports single date or range.

name: get_pc_aw_heatmap
description: Get PC active-window heatmap (raw). Returns HeatmapBucket[].

name: get_pc_keystats_range
description: Get PC keystats range. Returns KeystatsSummary[] per day.

name: get_pc_focus_blocks
description: Get PC focus blocks (deep work sessions) for range. Core for weekly report. Returns PcFocusBlocksResponse.

name: get_pc_app_usage
description: Get PC app usage aggregation. Returns PcAppUsageResponse sorted by duration.

name: get_pc_late_night
description: Get PC late-night usage aggregation. Returns PcLateNightResponse.

name: get_pc_category_distribution
description: Get PC category time distribution for range. Returns PcCategoryDistributionResponse.

name: get_pc_categories
description: List PC app category rules (flat). Returns AppCategoryRule[].

name: get_pc_category_tree
description: Get PC category tree (hierarchical). Returns CategoryTreeNode[].

name: get_pc_category_dictionary
description: Get PC category dictionary (flat list with metadata). Returns CategoryDictionaryItemDto[].

name: get_pc_productivity_dashboard
description: Get PC productivity dashboard for a day. Returns ProductivityDashboardDto.

name: get_pc_productivity_range
description: Get PC productivity range (weekly). Returns DailyProductivityDto[] per day.

name: get_classification_rules
description: List PC activity classification rules. Returns ActivityClassificationRuleDto[].

name: get_classification_suggestions
description: List classification suggestions for a day. Returns ActivityClassificationSuggestionDto[].

name: get_classification_queue
description: Get classification labeling queue. Returns ActivityLabelingQueueResponse.

name: get_classification_project_tags_recent
description: Get recent project tags for classification. Returns string[].

name: get_app_knowledge_apps
description: List app-knowledge apps. Returns AppKnowledgeAppDto[] with optional search.

name: get_app_knowledge_contexts
description: Get contexts for an app-knowledge app. Returns AppKnowledgeContextDto[].

name: get_app_signatures
description: List app signatures (process -> app mapping). Returns AppSignatureDto[].

name: lookup_app_signature
description: Lookup app signature by process name. Returns AppSignatureDto or 404.

name: get_classification_settings
description: Get classification settings. Returns ActivityClassificationSettingsDto.

name: get_mobile_summary
description: Get mobile usage summary for a day (separate from timeline). Returns MobileUsageSummaryResponse.

name: get_mobile_timeline
description: Get mobile timeline for a day (app usage sessions). Returns MobileTimelineResponse.

name: get_mobile_location_history
description: Get mobile location history in range. Returns MobileLocationHistoryResponse with points.

name: get_mobile_location_latest
description: Get latest mobile location point. Returns single point (history with latest).

name: get_mobile_location_tracks
description: Get mobile location tracks (clustered). Returns MobileLocationTrackDto[].

name: get_mobile_location_overview
description: Get mobile location overview (distance, stay, movement). Returns MobileLocationAnalyticsOverviewResponse.

name: get_mobile_location_frequent_places
description: Get frequent places derived from location. Returns MobileFrequentPlacesResponse.

name: get_mobile_location_movement_stats
description: Get movement stats (speed, distance, active time). Returns MobileMovementStatsResponse.

name: get_mobile_quality
description: Get mobile collection quality for a day. Returns MobileQualityResponse.

name: get_mobile_analytics_overview
description: Get mobile analytics overview (usage). Core for weekly report. Returns MobileAnalyticsOverviewResponse.

name: get_mobile_analytics_heatmap
description: Get mobile analytics heatmap (hourly). Returns MobileHeatmapBucketDto[].

name: get_mobile_analytics_charts
description: Get mobile analytics charts data. Returns MobileAnalyticsChartDto[].

name: get_mobile_timeline_blocks
description: Get mobile timeline blocks (aggregated sessions). Returns MobileTimelineBlockPageDto.

name: get_mobile_devices
description: List mobile devices (simple). Returns MobileDeviceDto[].

name: get_mobile_devices_manage
description: List mobile devices with management info, optional sortBy. Returns DeviceListDto[].

name: get_mobile_apps_catalog_overrides
description: List mobile app catalog overrides. Returns MobileAppCatalogOverrideDto[].

name: get_mobile_apps_category_rules
description: List mobile app category rules. Returns MobileAppCategoryRuleDto[].

name: get_mobile_goals
description: List mobile usage goals. Returns MobileUsageGoalDto[].

name: get_quick_notes
description: List quick notes with optional status and search. Returns PagedResult<QuickNoteListItemDto>.

name: get_quick_note
description: Get single quick note by id. Returns QuickNoteDetailDto.

name: get_quick_note_attachment_meta
description: Get quick note attachment metadata (not binary). Returns download info meta. If API streams binary, returns headers only.

name: get_file_providers
description: List file providers (e.g. Nextcloud). Returns FileProviderDto[].

name: get_files
description: List files with optional folder. Returns FileListResponse (paged).

name: get_file
description: Get single file item by id. Returns FileItemDto.

name: get_file_versions
description: List versions for a file. Returns FileVersion[].

name: get_file_trash
description: List file trash items. Returns ProviderTrashItem[].

name: search_files
description: Search files (fulltext + semantic). Core for RAG. Returns FileSearchResponse (paged).

name: get_file_suggestions
description: List file organization suggestions. Returns FileSuggestion[].

name: get_file_open_link
description: Get open link for a file (WebDAV/Nextcloud). Returns {openLink}. Note: may contain url, hashed if redactUrls implicit. Call with redact handling.

name: get_today_sections
description: Get today sections registry (all sections for a day). Returns TodaySectionRegistryDto. date YYYY-MM-DD or omit for today.

name: get_today_section
description: Get single today section by id. Returns TodaySectionDto.

name: search_pim
description: Global search across PIM (events, tasks, notes, files). Returns PagedResult<SearchResult>. type comma-separated e.g. 'event,task,note,file'.

name: get_system_status
description: Get system status (overall). Returns StatusResponse. Maps to GET /status.

name: get_system_health
description: Get health check. Returns {status, timestamp}. Maps to GET /health (allow anonymous but we pass token).

name: get_status_summary
description: Get status summary (counts). Returns SummaryResponse. Maps to GET /status/summary.

name: get_ai_status
description: Get AI gateway status. Returns {enabled, model, health}. Maps to GET /ai/status.

name: get_ai_requests
description: List AI requests with filters. Returns PagedResult<AiRequest>.

name: get_ai_usage_summary
description: Get AI usage summary in range. Returns {totalRequests, tokens, cost}. Maps to GET /ai/usage/summary?from&to.

name: get_audit_timeline
description: Get audit timeline for an object. Returns AuditVersion[] for objectType/objectId.

name: get_audit_export
description: Export audit log in range (operations). Returns AuditExport.

name: get_confirmations_pending
description: List pending confirmations needing human approval. Returns OperationConfirmationDto[].

name: get_endpoints
description: List registered endpoints/clients. Returns EndpointDto[].

name: get_version
description: Get API version info. Returns {version, gitSha, buildTime}. Maps to GET /api/version.

name: create_event
description: Create a calendar event. Requires write permission create_event. Returns the created EventResponse.

name: update_event
description: Update a calendar event. scope=This/Series with recurrenceId updates repeating events. Requires write permission update_event.

name: delete_event
description: Delete a calendar event (moves to recycle bin). scope=This/Series for repeating events. Requires write permission delete_event.

name: restore_event
description: Restore a deleted event from the recycle bin. Requires write permission restore_event.

name: batch_delete_events
description: Batch delete events by ids (move to recycle bin). Requires write permission batch_delete_events.

name: create_task
description: Create a task. estimatedDuration/minimumSegment use formats like '1h30m'. Requires write permission create_task.

name: update_task
description: Update a task (status/priority/due dates). Requires write permission update_task.

name: delete_task
description: Delete a task (moves to recycle bin). Requires write permission delete_task.

name: restore_task
description: Restore a deleted task from the recycle bin. Requires write permission restore_task.

name: move_task
description: Move a task (change project or ordering). duration is a TimeSpan string like '01:30:00'. Requires write permission move_task.

name: plan_task
description: Schedule a task onto the calendar (which day it will be done). Requires write permission plan_task.

name: create_task_segment
description: Add an execution segment (a concrete time block) to a task. Requires write permission create_task_segment.

name: delete_task_segment
description: Delete a task execution segment. Requires write permission delete_task_segment.

name: add_task_checklist_item
description: Add a checklist item to a task. Requires write permission add_task_checklist_item.

name: batch_delete_tasks
description: Batch delete tasks by ids (move to recycle bin). Requires write permission batch_delete_tasks.

name: batch_update_tasks
description: Batch update tasks (status/priority/calendar). At least one of status/priority/calendarId is required. Requires write permission batch_update_tasks.

name: create_task_book
description: Create a task book (a container for tasks). Requires write permission create_task_book.

name: create_project
description: Create a domain project (a top-level domain for tasks). Requires write permission create_project.

name: schedule_tasks
description: Run the scheduling engine to place tasks onto the calendar. Requires write permission schedule_tasks.

name: create_reminder
description: Create a reminder for a related object (e.g. a task). Requires write permission create_reminder.

name: snooze_reminder
description: Snooze a reminder (defaults to +15 minutes). Requires write permission snooze_reminder.

name: dismiss_reminder
description: Dismiss/close a reminder. Requires write permission dismiss_reminder.

name: create_habit
description: Create a habit routine. Requires write permission create_habit.

name: create_habit_occurrence
description: Log a habit occurrence (check-in). Requires write permission create_habit_occurrence.

name: create_availability_window
description: Create an availability window (a block of free time usable for scheduling). Requires write permission create_availability_window.

name: import_ics
description: Import an ICS calendar file (pass the raw ICS text). Requires write permission import_ics.

name: create_calendar
description: Create a calendar. Requires write permission create_calendar.

name: update_calendar
description: Update a calendar. Requires write permission update_calendar.

name: delete_calendar
description: Delete a calendar (recycle bin). Requires write permission delete_calendar.

name: restore_calendar
description: Restore a deleted calendar from the recycle bin. Requires write permission restore_calendar.

name: create_quick_note
description: Create a quick note. Requires write permission create_quick_note.

name: update_quick_note
description: Update a quick note (content/status/attachments). Requires write permission update_quick_note.

name: delete_quick_note
description: Delete a quick note. Requires write permission delete_quick_note.

name: archive_quick_note
description: Archive a quick note. Requires write permission archive_quick_note.

name: restore_quick_note
description: Restore an archived quick note (default status 'inbox'). Requires write permission restore_quick_note.

name: process_quick_note
description: Process a quick note through AI/rules (sets status to processed). Requires write permission process_quick_note.

name: upload_quick_note_attachment
description: Upload an attachment for a quick note (base64 content). Returns attachment id to reference in create/update note. Requires write permission upload_quick_note_attachment.

name: delete_quick_note_attachment
description: Delete a quick note attachment. Requires write permission delete_quick_note_attachment.

name: upload_file
description: Upload a file to a provider path (base64 content). Requires write permission upload_file.

name: move_file
description: Move a file to a new path. Requires write permission move_file.

name: rename_file
description: Rename a file. Requires write permission rename_file.

name: delete_file
description: Delete a file (moves to trash). Requires write permission delete_file.

name: restore_file
description: Restore a file from trash. trashId identifies the trash entry. Requires write permission restore_file.

name: index_file
description: Trigger file indexing for RAG search. Requires write permission index_file.

name: create_category
description: Create a PC activity category (maps an app pattern to a category). Requires write permission create_category.

name: update_categories_order
description: Reorder PC categories. items: [{id, parentId?, sortOrder}]. Requires write permission update_categories_order.

name: delete_category
description: Delete a PC category. Requires write permission delete_category.

name: seed_categories
description: Seed default PC categories. Requires write permission seed_categories.

name: create_mobile_goal
description: Create a mobile usage goal (daily limit). Requires write permission create_mobile_goal.

name: delete_mobile_goal
description: Delete a mobile usage goal. Requires write permission delete_mobile_goal.
